purpose: Supplementary post-hoc comparison; primary experiment retained
target_scale: Attachment 4 standardized continuous scale, not original 0-6 scores

protocols.random_3fold: Same 3 shuffled folds and training-only imputation for all four models
protocols.unseen_style_3fold: Whole fine styles excluded from training; Mean and ExtraTrees only
protocols.stress: 20 test-mask draws per 10%/20% rate; masks are paired and nested; models remain unchanged

models.extra_trees:
Pipeline(steps=[('imputer',
                 SimpleImputer(add_indicator=True, keep_empty_features=True,
                               strategy='median')),
                ('model',
                 ExtraTreesRegressor(max_features=0.7, min_samples_leaf=3,
                                     n_estimators=300, n_jobs=1,
                                     random_state=20261025))])
models.gbr_per_target:
Pipeline(steps=[('imputer',
                 SimpleImputer(add_indicator=True, keep_empty_features=True,
                               strategy='median')),
                ('model',
                 MultiOutputRegressor(estimator=GradientBoostingRegressor(learning_rate=0.05,
                                                                          max_depth=2,
                                                                          min_samples_leaf=5,
                                                                          random_state=20261025),
                                      n_jobs=1))])
models.hgb_per_target:
Pipeline(steps=[('imputer',
                 SimpleImputer(add_indicator=True, keep_empty_features=True,
                               strategy='median')),
                ('model',
                 MultiOutputRegressor(estimator=HistGradientBoostingRegressor(early_stopping=False,
                                                                              l2_regularization=1.0,
                                                                              learning_rate=0.05,
                                                                              max_leaf_nodes=7,
                                                                              min_samples_leaf=10,
                                                                              random_state=20261025),
                                      n_jobs=1))])

limitations: Same 250 beers as development; a new split is not an independent data set.
One fixed parameter set per model; not a tuned-family superiority claim.
45-output ExtraTrees shares splits; boosting models fit each target separately.
Random and style-group protocols answer different deployment questions.
MCAR test masking does not model detection limits, training-set missingness, or instrument failures.
Attachment creators' precomputed global transformations cannot be undone.
